item.title: Search suspended for missing Northern Michigan student
item.description: Police in Marquette have suspended their search for Northern Michigan University student Trenton Massey, who was last seen early Sunday morning.

item.title: Michigan woman with Down syndrome inspires federal push to shield vulnerable adults from online abuse
item.description: U.S. Reps. Debbie Dingell and Haley Stevens have introduced the Justice for Allie Act, which would make it a federal crime to knowingly coerce, manipulate or entice a vulnerable adult into sending intimate images with the intent to cause harm, inspired by the case of a Michigan woman with Down syndrome who was targeted by an online predator.

item.title: Whitmer, lawmakers promise more housing, fewer regulations — but builders aren't buying it
item.description: Michigan lawmakers are proposing changes to zoning rules and tax credits to incentivize construction of affordable homes, but builders argue that it will take more than that to make new construction affordable again, such as lowering interest rates and improving infrastructure.
